explanation: The central figure in Christianity who performed miracles and taught about the Kingdom of God.
The ruler of Galilee who feared Jesus because of his growing popularity.
The cousin of Jesus' mother, a prophet who preached about the coming Messiah before he was executed.
The act of taking someone's life by legal judgment or order from authorities.
Special events performed by Jesus that break natural laws and demonstrate God's power, such as the feeding miracle.
Five loaves of bread which, together with two fish, were blessed by Jesus to feed thousands of people.
A miracle in which Jesus walked across the surface of the sea while his disciples were in danger from a storm.
A town on the Sea of Galilee where Jesus and his disciples went after walking on water.
